title: Lakehouse: Spark master failover (ZooKeeper auto-promote, ~30s)
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster lakehouse --direction spark-master --yes`. Stops nexus-spark-master on the ALIVE leader; ZooKeeper promotes the STANDBY master to ALIVE (and the workers re-register). The stopped master is restarted as the new STANDBY.

observe.what: the ALIVE master is stopped, ZK promotes the standby to ALIVE (RTO ~30s), the old leader restarts as STANDBY; recovery=recovered

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.FailoverAsync (spark-master) stops the ALIVE master and polls the surviving standby until ZooKeeper elects it ALIVE, measuring the RTO; the workers re-register against the new leader.
